tests.command_form: PYTHONPATH=src uv run --no-sources --with-editable '.[test]' python -m pytest <paths> -q -p no:cacheprovider --basetemp=<scratch>

finite_rotation_reference.method: Independent three-equation body-frame force balance: T_i=(EA_i/L_i) max(|H-P_i|-L_i,0); sum(T_i u_i)=W (H-CoG)/|H-CoG|. No self-stress projection; force residual/W below 1e-9.

evidence_limits: Only supplied CoG corners are evaluated, not a continuous-envelope maximum
Nominal rigid rotation with linear spring/tolerance displacements; directions are frozen about that pose, not updated for elastic stretch or errors
CoG z equals the nominal eye plane; payload warp limited to centred rectangles; tilts above 3 degrees flagged for separate assessment
Reference errors below 0.3 percent apply to the checked examples, not an arbitrary-geometry bound
Published catalog example validates inclined two-leg equilibrium only, not indeterminate skew or flexible-frame response
DNV four-leg minimum assumes a matched set without spreaders within the cited POU standard scope; applicability needs separate assessment
No physical experimental validation, licensed solver execution, or formal engineering clearance
